feature_definitions.soxl_downside_beta_gap_252: rolling 252d SOXL beta on negative SOXX days minus unconditional beta
feature_definitions.soxl_fragility_curvature_504: rolling downside loss acceleration across 0-1, 1-2, and >2 sigma SOXX shock buckets
feature_definitions.soxl_levered_decay_acceleration_5: five-day change in rolling 20d SOXL return minus 3x SOXX return
feature_definitions.soxx_downside_semivariance_share_20: rolling 20d negative squared returns divided by total squared returns
feature_definitions.soxx_es_var_ratio_504: rolling 504d absolute expected-shortfall to VaR ratio at 5%
feature_definitions.soxx_exceedance_intensity_60: rolling 60d frequency below the lagged rolling 252d 5% quantile
feature_definitions.soxx_jump_ratio_20: rolling 20d non-negative daily RV minus bipower variation share
feature_definitions.soxx_rebalance_drag_pressure_20: 3 times rolling 20d SOXX squared-return sum, the 3x path drag proxy
feature_definitions.soxx_tail_loss_concentration_252: five largest rolling 252d SOXX losses divided by all losses
feature_definitions.soxx_tail_xi_504: rolling 504d lower-tail Hill xi using the largest 10% losses
feature_definitions.soxx_tail_xi_instability: absolute disagreement between rolling 252d and 756d Hill xi
feature_definitions.tail_risk_premium_9d: VIX9D annualized variance minus rolling 9d SOXX realized variance
feature_definitions.vix9d_vix3m_z_126: rolling 126d z-score of VIX9D divided by VIX3M
feature_definitions.vvix_vix_z_126: rolling 126d z-score of VVIX divided by VIX
